sections.title: Location and Contact
sections.text:
Status: available

New Tampa Eye Institute has two locations: Wesley Chapel, 27356 Cashford Cir, Wesley Chapel, FL 33544; and Dade City, 13930 7th Street, Dade City, FL 33525. Public office phone for all departments: (813) 994-7000. This demonstration is reached at (320) 738-8132. The public number is general office contact, not a verified direct on-call physician number.

sections.title: Scope of Services
sections.text:
Status: available

Public services include comprehensive eye exams, cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, dry eye, oculoplastics, tearing and eyelid dysfunction, and cosmetic treatments. Routine vision and optical questions should be distinguished from medical disease care.

sections.title: Providers
sections.text:
Status: available

- Doctor Gretta Fridman, M.D.: glaucoma and cataract specialist.
- Doctor Laurie Small, M.D.: oculoplastics specialist; eyelid concerns.
- Doctor Scott Friedman, M.D.: retina specialist; retinal conditions such as macular degeneration or diabetic retinopathy.
- Doctor Hirah Khan, M.D.: glaucoma specialist.
- Doctor Bradley Smur, O.D.: optometrist providing primary eye care and comprehensive eye exams. The website also spells his surname Smurr in the biography.

Gretta Fridman and Scott Friedman are different physicians with similar-sounding surnames. For this v1 demo, routine exams route to Doctor Bradley Smur. Doctor Scott Friedman specializes in retina care; Doctor Bradley Smur handles glasses prescriptions and routine exams. Availability, provider location, and individual clinical suitability require tool or staff confirmation.

sections.title: Insurance and Referrals
sections.text:
Status: available

The site says the practice accepts most medical health insurance but supplies no verified plan-by-plan contract list. The medical and routine vision insurance files are demonstration fixtures adapted from the existing ophthalmology demo, not actual New Tampa contracts. Any insurance participation match is a demo result. Medical coverage and vision benefits are distinct. Eligibility, provider network, service coverage, referrals, authorizations, copays, deductibles, and payment require verification.
